name: Project Lyra 1b
source: Hibberd, Hein & Eubanks 2020, Project Lyra: catching 1I/'Oumuamua, mission opportunities after 2024 (Acta Astronautica 170, arXiv:1902.04935), Table 2 scenario B (E-DSM-E-J-6SR-1I): launch 2030 Jun 09, deep space manoeuvre at 3.2 au, Earth flyby, Jupiter 2034 Jul 12, solar Oberth manoeuvre at 6 solar radii, 'Oumuamua 2052 Jul 29. The manoeuvre date and direction and the Earth flyby date are not published and were fitted; the solar dive solved by shooting onto Horizons' 'Oumuamua position. The 'Oumuamua path is JPL Horizons (JPL#16).
